thin: No official list covers clothing or household goods: the City of Mesa names only Paz de Cristo and Bridging AZ. 211 returns 8 clothing and 8 household-goods results, and the household ones are mostly Phoenix/Peoria. Furniture for the general public is the thinnest: the only Mesa furniture source (Bridging AZ) is agency-referred. findhelp and NeedHelpPayingBills returned 403.
